ko.title: 투스피드 소비 패턴: 소득별 소비 양극화가 연말 연시를 앞둔 경제에 말해주는 것

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: 연휴 쇼핑 시즌이 다가오면서 미국 소비자의 모습은 단일한 형태라기보다 두 가지 양상으로 갈라지고 있습니다.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: 고소득 가구는 일반적으로 여행, 외식 및 고가품 구매에 대한 지출을 계속 유지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: 반면, 많은 저소득 및 중소득 가구는 더 저렴한 브랜드를 선택하고, 할인 행사를 기다리며, 비필수적 지출을 줄이는 등 훨씬 신중한 태도를 보이고 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 이러한 양상을 자주 "투스피드(two-speed)" 또는 "K자형" 소비자 패턴으로 설명하며, 소비자 지출이 미국 전체의 약 3분의 2를 차지한다는 점에서 이는 매우 중요합니다.

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: 경제 활동.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: 본 문서에서는 이러한 양극화가 발생한 원인, 심리 조사 및 소매업체 동향에서 유의해 볼 점, 그리고 소매업, 고용, 성장에 미칠 영향에 대해 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 본 콘텐츠는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 재무적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## 지출 양극화가 발생하는 이유

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: 여러 요인이 동시에 작용하여 가구들을 서로 다른 방향으로 이끄는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **자산 가치와 저축 여력.** 주식, 주택 또는 기타 자산을 보유하고 있거나 최근 몇 년 동안 저축을 축적한 가구는 종종 스스로 더 부유하고 안정적이라고 느낍니다. 이러한 느낌은 물가가 높아진 상황에서도 지출을 받쳐주는 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **일부 가구에 더 큰 부담이 되는 생활비.** 식료품, 임대료, 보험료, 공공요금 등은 저소득 및 중소득 가구 예산에서 더 큰 비중을 차지합니다. 이러한 비용이 소득보다 빠르게 상승하면 다른 곳에 쓸 여력이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **차입 비용의 증가.** 금리가 높아지면 예산 균형을 맞추기 위해 대출에 의존하는 가구의 신용카드 잔액, 자동차 담보 대출 및 금융 비용 부담이 더욱 커집니다.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **고용 및 임금 격차.** 임금 상승률과 고용 안정이 모든 산업과 소득 계층에 균등하게 분배되지 않으므로, 향후 몇 달에 대해 각 가구가 느끼는 소비 심리에 차이가 생깁니다.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## "디트레이딩(Trading down)"은 어떤 모습인가

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: 더 저렴한 상품을 찾는 디트레이딩이 반드시 소비를 완전히 중단하는 것을 의미하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: 이는 쇼핑 방식을 변경한다는 뜻입니다.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: 흔히 나타나는 행동은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - 유명 브랜드 대신 자체 브랜드(PB) 상품 선택

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - 할인점, 창고형 할인매장, 아울렛 등으로 구매처 전환

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - 더 작은 포장 단위를 구매하거나 1회 방문당 구매 품목 수 축소

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - 선구매 후결제(BNPL) 서비스, 쿠폰, 적립 혜택을 보다 적극적으로 활용

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - 가구나 전자제품 같은 대형 구매는 판촉 행사가 열릴 때까지 연기

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: 한편 고소득 소비자는 프리미엄 제품과 경험재 구매를 계속 유지할 가능성이 높으며, 이는 일부 대중 소비재 판매업체가 신중해진 고객을 언급하는 반면 일부 럭셔리 및 여행 관련 기업은 견조한 수요를 발표하는 이유를 설명해 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## 소비자 심리 조사 읽는 법

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: The Conference Board 및 University of Michigan의 널리 참조되는 지표를 포함한 소비자 신뢰 및 심리 조사는 유용하지만 완벽하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: 헤드라인 수치 뒤에는 중요한 세부적 차이가 숨겨져 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: 새로운 지표가 발표될 때 다음 사항을 확인하면 도움이 됩니다:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **소득 및 연령별 세부 내역.** 고소득 응답자가 다른 집단보다 눈에 띄게 더 낙관적인 반응을 보이는가?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **현재 상황 대비 기대 심리.** 현재에 대한 인식과 향후 6개월에 대한 기대치 사이의 격차는 고용이나 물가에 대한 우려를 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **지출 의향.** 주요 품목 구매, 휴가, 연휴 예산 계획 등은 다가오는 시즌 지출에 대한 힌트를 제공합니다.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **인플레이션 기대 심리.** 가구가 물가가 계속 오를 것으로 예상하면 지출을 더 일찍 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: 사람들이 말하는 것과 실제로 행동하는 것이 다를 수 있다는 점도 기억할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: 심리는 신호일 뿐 보증 수표가 아니므로, 소매업체와 정부 보고서의 실제 지출 데이터로 현실적인 검증을 해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## 소매업체가 투자자들에게 전하는 메시지

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: 실적 발표회(Earnings calls)와 기업 실적 업데이트는 양극화를 실시간으로 확인해 볼 수 있는 가장 좋은 창 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: 단일 발언보다는 지속적으로 등장하는 주제에 집중하여 살펴보세요:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **가성비 중심 소매업체**는 더 저렴한 가격을 찾는 쇼핑객들로 인해 매장 방문객(Traffic)이 증가했음을 자주 강조합니다.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **중저가 및 백화점형 소매업체**는 더 많은 판촉 활동과 더 타이트한 재고 관리에 대해 언급할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **프리미엄 및 경험 중심 기업**은 부유한 고객층의 견고한 수요를 지목할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - 경영진이 고객의 정밀한 가격 비교가 지속될 것으로 예상할 때는 "신중한(cautious)", "선택적인(choiceful)", "가성비를 찾는(value-seeking)"과 같은 **가이던스 용어**가 자주 등장합니다.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: 소매업체들은 또한 채용 계획을 통해 자신들의 기대를 드러냅니다.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: 특히 연휴 시즌 임시 채용 공고는 기업들이 연휴 수요에 대해 얼마나 자신감을 갖고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## 소매, 고용, 성장에 미칠 의미

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **소매.** 양극화된 소비 양상은 전체 금액 합계는 양호해 보이지만 내부는 불균형한 연휴 시즌을 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: 일부 카테고리와 가격대는 뛰어난 성과를 거두는 반면, 다른 쪽은 할인에 크게 의존하여 매출이 유지되더라도 수익성이 악화될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **고용.** 소매, 숙박·음식점, 물류 분야의 고용주는 수요에 맞춰 인력을 조정합니다.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: 신중해진 쇼핑객이 예상보다 소비를 크게 줄이면 특히 중소득층 고객을 대상으로 하는 부문에서 채용이 둔화될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: 반면 상위 계층의 꾸준한 지출은 노동 시장의 충격을 완화하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **성장.** 고소득층이 전체 소비에서 차지하는 비중이 크기 때문에, 상위 계층의 견조한 지출은 당분간 전체 경제 성장을 떠받칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: 위험 요인은 쏠림 현상입니다. 자산 가격 하락 등의 이유로 해당 집단이 지출을 줄이면 이를 대체할 광범위한 지출 기반이 부족해집니다.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: 반대로 인플레이션이 지속적으로 둔화되고 임금이 계속 상승하면 나머지 가구의 부담이 완화되어 격차가 줄어들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## 연말까지 주목해야 할 주요 신호

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - GDP 추정치에 반영되는 통제집단(Control-group) 매출을 포함한 월간 소매 판매 보고서

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - Federal Reserve Bank of New York 및 기타 기관의 연체율 및 신용카드 잔액 동향

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - 주간 신규 실업수당 청구 건수 및 월간 비농업 고용 보고서

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - 인플레이션 지표, 특히 식료품, 주거비, 서비스 물가

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - 업계 단체의 연휴 시즌 매출 전망치와 12월 및 1월의 실제 결과 비교

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## 가구를 위한 실용적인 제언

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: 가구가 소비 격차의 어느 쪽에 해당하든 연휴 시즌은 예산을 신중하게 계획하기 좋은 시기입니다.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: 쇼핑 전 확정된 선물 예산 설정하기, 가격 비교하기, 환불 정책 확인하기, 새해까지 이어질 부채 피하기 등을 실천하면 연휴 시즌의 스트레스를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: 예산에 여유가 있는 가구는 소비 패턴 변화의 영향을 가장 먼저 받기 쉬운 지역 소상공인을 지원하는 것도 고려해 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: 2026년 연휴 경제 이야기는 단순히 "호황"이라거나 "불황"이라는 단어로 규정할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: 이는 동일한 헤드라인 수치 뒤에 숨겨진 서로 다른 경험에 대한 이야기입니다.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: 소비 심리, 소매업체 코멘트, 실제 지출 데이터가 어떻게 일치해 가는지 지켜보는 것은 새해를 맞이하며 이 두 가지 속도의 소비 패턴이 좁혀질지 아니면 더 벌어질지에 대한 가장 명확한 그림을 제공할 것입니다.

zh.title: 双速消费者：按收入划分的分化支出对节日期间经济的启示

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: 随着节日购物季的临近，美国消费者看起来越来越不像是一个单一的整体，而更像是两个群体。

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: 收入阶层偏上的家庭总体上保持了在旅游、外出就餐和大件商品上的支出。

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: 相比之下，许多低收入和中等收入家庭则更加挑剔：降级购买更便宜的品牌、等待促销活动，并削减可自由支配的额外开支。

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常将这种模式描述为“双速”或“K型”消费者，这很重要，因为消费者支出约占美国经济活动的。

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: 经济活动的三分之二左右。

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: 本文探讨了这一分化为何出现、在信心调查和零售商评论中应关注什么，以及它对零售、就业和增长可能意味着什么。

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 本文为一般信息，不构成财务建议。

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## 为什么支出正在分化

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: 几种力量往往同时将家庭推向不同的方向。

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **资产价值与储蓄缓冲。** 拥有股票、房屋或其他资产并在近年积累了储蓄的家庭，往往会感到更富裕、更有安全感。即使价格高企，这种感觉也能支撑支出。

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **日常成本对部分人构成了更大压力。** 对于低收入和中等收入家庭来说，食品杂货、房租、保险和公用事业占了预算的更大份额。当这些成本的上涨速度快于薪水时，留给其他一切的资金就会减少。

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **借贷成本更高。** 对于依赖借贷来平抑预算的家庭来说，更高的利率使得信用卡余额、汽车贷款和融资成本更加沉重。

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **工作和工资差异。** 工资增长和工作安全感在不同行业和收入水平之间分布不均，这影响了不同家庭对未来几个月的信心。

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## “消费降级”是什么样的

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: 消费降级并不一定意味着人们停止购物。

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: 这意味着他们改变了购物方式。

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: 常见的行为包括：

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - 选择商店自有品牌而非名牌

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - 将采购转向折扣零售商、仓储会员店和品牌折扣店

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - 购买更小包装或减少每次购物的商品数量

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - 更积极地使用先买后付计划、优惠券和忠诚度奖励

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - 推迟购买家具或电子产品等大宗商品，直到促销出现

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: 与此同时，高收入购物者更有可能继续购买高端商品和体验，这有助于解释为什么一些奢侈品和旅游相关企业报告需求稳定，而一些大众市场卖家则形容客户更加谨慎。

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## 解读信心调查

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: 消费者信心和情绪调查（包括备受关注的世界大型企业联合会和密歇根大学的读数）很有用但不完美。

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: 它们的头条数字可能会掩盖底层的重大差异。

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: 在查看新发布的数据时，有助于检查：

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **按收入和年龄细分。** 高收入受访者的语气是否明显比其他人更乐观？

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **预期与当前状况。** 人们对现状的看法与对未来六个月的预期之间的差距可能预示着对工作或价格的担忧。

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **支出意向。** 对主要采购、度假和节日预算的计划为即将到来的季节提供了线索。

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **通胀预期。** 如果家庭预期价格继续攀升，他们可能会更快地缩减开支。

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: 同样值得记住的是，人们所说的话和他们的实际行动可能会有所不同。

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: 情绪是一个信号，而不是保证，来自零售商和政府报告的支出数据提供了必要的现实检验。

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## 零售商在向投资者传达什么

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: 财报电话会议和公司更新是了解分化的最佳实时窗口之一。

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: 在阅读这些内容时，请倾听反复出现的主题，而不是任何单一的引言：

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **注重价值的零售商**通常会强调客流量的增加，因为购物者在寻求更低的价格。

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **中端和百货商店式零售商**可能会谈到更多的促销活动和更紧凑的库存规划。

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **高端和体验导向型企业**可能会指出富裕客户群体的需求依然强劲。

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **指引语言**（如“谨慎”、“精打细算”或“寻求价值”）往往会在管理层预计客户将继续审查价格时出现。

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: 零售商还通过招聘计划透露他们的预期。

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: 特别是季节性招聘公告，表明了公司对节日需求的信心。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## 它对零售、就业和增长意味着什么

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **零售。** 双速消费者可能会创造这样一个节日季：总金额看起来不错，但底层却参差不齐。

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: 某些类别和价格区间可能会表现出色，而其他类别则严重依赖折扣，即使销售额保持不变，这也可能会挤压利润率。

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **就业。** 零售、酒店和物流雇主会调整人员配备以匹配需求。

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: 如果谨慎的购物者缩减开支的幅度超出预期，招聘可能会放缓，尤其是在服务于中等收入客户的行业中。

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: 另一方面，顶层稳定的支出可以帮助缓冲劳动力市场。

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **增长。** 由于富裕阶层占总消费的大份额，顶层强劲的支出可以在一段时间内保持整体增长。

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: 风险在于集中度：如果该群体缩减开支（或许是因为资产价格下跌），就没有足够的基础广泛的支出能够取而代之。

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: 相反，如果通胀继续降温且工资持续上涨，其余家庭的压力可能会缓解，差距可能会缩小。

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## 年底值得关注的信号

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - 月度零售销售报告，包括计入GDP估计的对照组销售额

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - 纽约联邦储备银行和其他来源的拖欠率和信用卡余额趋势

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - 每周失业救济申请人数和每月工资单报告

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - 通胀读数，特别是食品、住房和服务方面的读数

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - 行业机构的节日销售预测，与12月和1月的实际结果进行比较

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## 给家庭的实用建议

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: 无论一个家庭落在哪一边，节日季都是仔细规划的好时机。

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: 在购物前设定坚定的礼品预算、比较价格、检查退货政策，并避免会延续到新年的债务，可以使节日压力减小。

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: 预算有额外余地的家庭也可以考虑支持当地企业，这些企业往往最先感受到消费者习惯变化的影响。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: 2026年节日经济的故事不只是简单的“强”或“弱”。

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: 这是一个在相同的头条数字下有着不同经历的故事。

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: 观察信心、零售商评论和硬性支出数据如何保持一致，将为随着新年的开始这两种速度是会汇聚还是进一步拉开提供最清晰的图景。

segments.tr: - प्रमोशन आने तक फर्नीचर या इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स जैसी बड़ी खरीदारी में देरी करना

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: इस बीच, उच्च आय वाले खरीदार प्रीमियम सामान और अनुभवों को खरीदना जारी रखने की अधिक संभावना रखते हैं, जो यह समझाने में मदद करता है कि कुछ विलासिता और यात्रा से संबंधित व्यवसाय स्थिर मांग की रिपोर्ट क्यों करते हैं जबकि कुछ बड़े पैमाने पर बाजार विक्रेता अधिक सतर्क ग्राहक का वर्णन करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## विश्वास सर्वेक्षण पढ़ना

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता विश्वास और भावना सर्वेक्षण, जिसमें द कॉन्फ्रेंस बोर्ड और मिशिगन विश्वविद्यालय के व्यापक रूप से फॉलो किए जाने वाले रीडिंग शामिल हैं, उपयोगी हैं लेकिन अपूर्ण हैं।

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: उनकी मुख्य संख्याएँ नीचे महत्वपूर्ण अंतरों को छुपा सकती हैं।

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: एक नई रिलीज़ को देखते समय, यह जांचने में मदद करता है:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **आय और आयु के आधार पर ब्रेकडाउन।** क्या उच्च आय वाले उत्तरदाता दूसरों की तुलना में काफी अधिक उत्साहित लगते हैं?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **उम्मीदें बनाम वर्तमान स्थितियां।** लोग वर्तमान को कैसे देखते हैं और अगले छह महीनों के लिए क्या उम्मीद करते हैं, इसके बीच की खाई नौकरियों या कीमतों के बारे में चिंता का संकेत दे सकती है।

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **खर्च के इरादे।** प्रमुख खरीदारी, छुट्टियों और छुट्टियों के बजट के लिए योजनाएं आने वाले मौसम के बारे में संकेत देती हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदें।** यदि परिवारों को उम्मीद है कि कीमतें बढ़ती रहेंगी, तो वे जल्द ही पीछे हट सकते हैं।

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: यह भी याद रखने योग्य है कि लोग क्या कहते हैं और वे क्या करते हैं, इसमें अंतर हो सकता है।

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: भावना एक संकेत है, कोई गारंटी नहीं, और खुदरा विक्रेताओं और सरकारी रिपोर्टों से खर्च डेटा एक आवश्यक वास्तविकता जांच प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## खुदरा विक्रेता निवेशकों को क्या बता रहे हैं

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: अर्निंग कॉल और कंपनी अपडेट विभाजन में सबसे अच्छी वास्तविक समय की खिड़कियों में से एक हैं।

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: उन्हें पढ़ते समय, किसी एक उद्धरण के बजाय आवर्ती विषयों को सुनें:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **मूल्य-केंद्रित खुदरा विक्रेता** अक्सर ट्रैफिक लाभ को उजागर करते हैं क्योंकि खरीदार कम कीमतों की तलाश करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **मध्य-स्तरीय और विभाग-शैली के खुदरा विक्रेता** अधिक प्रचार गतिविधि और सख्त इन्वेंट्री योजना के बारे में बात कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **प्रीमियम और अनुभव-उन्मुख व्यवसाय** समृद्ध ग्राहकों से लचीली मांग की ओर इशारा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **मार्गदर्शन भाषा** जैसे "सतर्क", "पसंद करने योग्य", या "मूल्य-तलाशने वाले" तब दिखाई देती है जब प्रबंधक उम्मीद करते हैं कि ग्राहक कीमतों की जांच करना जारी रखेंगे।

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: खुदरा विक्रेता अपनी भर्ती योजनाओं के माध्यम से भी अपनी अपेक्षाओं का खुलासा करते हैं।

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: मौसमी भर्ती घोषणाएं, विशेष रूप से, यह संकेत देती हैं कि कंपनियां छुट्टियों की मांग के बारे में कितना आश्वस्त महसूस करती हैं।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## खुदरा, नौकरियों और विकास के लिए इसका क्या मतलब हो सकता है

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **खुदरा।** एक दो-गति वाला उपभोक्ता एक छुट्टियों का मौसम पैदा कर सकता है जो कुल डॉलर में ठीक दिखता है लेकिन नीचे असमान है।

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: कुछ श्रेणियां और मूल्य स्तर बेहतर प्रदर्शन कर सकते हैं जबकि अन्य छूटों पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करते हैं, जो बिक्री बने रहने पर भी लाभ मार्जिन को निचोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **नौकरियां।** खुदरा, आतिथ्य और रसद नियोक्ता मांग से मेल खाने के लिए स्टाफिंग को समायोजित करते हैं।

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: यदि सतर्क खरीदार उम्मीद से अधिक कटौती करते हैं, तो काम पर रखना धीमा हो सकता है, खासकर मध्यम आय वाले ग्राहकों की सेवा करने वाले क्षेत्रों में।

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: दूसरी ओर, शीर्ष पर स्थिर खर्च श्रम बाजार को कुशन करने में मदद कर सकता है।

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **विकास।** चूंकि संपन्न लोग कुल खपत का एक बड़ा हिस्सा हैं, इसलिए शीर्ष पर मजबूत खर्च कुछ समय के लिए समग्र विकास को बनाए रख सकता है।

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: जोखिम एकाग्रता है: यदि वह समूह पीछे हट जाता है, शायद परिसंपत्ति की कीमतों में गिरावट के कारण, तो इसकी जगह लेने के लिए कम व्यापक खर्च होता है।

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, यदि मुद्रास्फीति शांत होती रहती है और वेतन बढ़ता रहता है, तो बाकी परिवारों पर दबाव कम हो सकता है और अंतर कम हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: **वर्ष के अंत तक देखने लायक संकेत

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - मासिक खुदरा बिक्री रिपोर्ट, जिसमें कंट्रोल-ग्रुप बिक्री शामिल है जो जीडीपी अनुमानों में फ़ीड करती है

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - न्यूयॉर्क के फेडरल रिजर्व बैंक और अन्य स्रोतों से delinquency और क्रेडिट कार्ड शेष रुझान

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - साप्ताहिक बेराजगार दावे और मासिक पेरोल रिपोर्ट

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - मुद्रास्फीति रीडिंग, विशेष रूप से भोजन, आवास और सेवाओं के लिए

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - दिसंबर और जनवरी में वास्तविक परिणामों की तुलना में, उद्योग समूहों से छुट्टियों की बिक्री के पूर्वानुमान

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## परिवारों के लिए व्यावहारिक टेकअवे

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: विभाजन के किसी भी पक्ष पर एक परिवार पड़ता है, छुट्टियों का मौसम सावधानी से योजना बनाने का एक अच्छा क्षण है।

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: खरीदारी से पहले एक निश्चित उपहार बजट निर्धारित करना, कीमतों की तुलना करना, वापसी नीतियों की जांच करना, और नए साल में रहने वाले ऋण से बचना मौसम को कम तनावपूर्ण बना सकता है।

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: अपने बजट में अतिरिक्त कमरे वाले परिवार स्थानीय व्यवसायों का समर्थन करने पर भी विचार कर सकते हैं, जो अक्सर बदलते उपभोक्ता आदतों के प्रभावों को पहले महसूस करते हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: 2026 की छुट्टियों की अर्थव्यवस्था की कहानी केवल "मजबूत" या "कमजोर" नहीं है।

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: यह एक ही शीर्षक संख्या के तहत अलग-अलग अनुभवों की कहानी है।

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: यह देखना कि कैसे आत्मविश्वास, खुदरा विक्रेता की टिप्पणी, और कठिन खर्च डेटा लाइन अप नए साल की शुरुआत के रूप में दो गति अभिसरण या आगे बहती है या नहीं की स्पष्ट तस्वीर देगा।

es.title: Un consumidor de dos velocidades: lo que dice el gasto divergente por ingresos sobre la economía de cara a las fiestas

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: A medida que se acerca la temporada de compras navideñas, el consumidor estadounidense se parece menos a una sola historia y más a dos.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: Los hogares en el extremo superior de la escala de ingresos generalmente han mantenido su gasto en viajes, cenas fuera de casa y compras de gran valor.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: Muchas familias de ingresos bajos y medios, por el contrario, están siendo más selectivas: optan por marcas más baratas, esperan las rebajas y recortan los extras discrecionales.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Los economistas suelen describir este patrón como un consumidor de "dos velocidades" o "en forma de K", y esto importa porque el gasto del consumidor representa aproximadamente dos tercios de la economía de EE.

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: UU.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: Este artículo analiza por qué ha surgido esta división, qué observar en las encuestas de confianza y los comentarios de los minoristas, y qué podría significar para el comercio minorista, el empleo y el crecimiento.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento financiero.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## Por qué el gasto está divergiendo

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: Varias fuerzas tienden a empujar a los hogares en diferentes direcciones al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **Valores de activos y colchones de ahorro.** Los hogares que poseen acciones, viviendas u otros activos, y que acumularon ahorros en los últimos años, a menudo se sienten más ricos y seguros. Esa sensación respalda el gasto incluso cuando los precios son elevados.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **Los costos cotidianos muerden más para algunos.** Los alimentos, el alquiler, los seguros y los servicios públicos consumen una mayor parte del presupuesto para las familias de ingresos bajos y medios. Cuando esos costos aumentan más rápido que los salarios, queda menos para cualquier otra cosa.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **Endeudarse es más caro.** Las tasas de interés más altas hacen que los saldos de las tarjetas de crédito, los préstamos para automóviles y los costos de financiación sean más pesados para los hogares que dependen del préstamo para equilibrar sus presupuestos.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Diferencias de empleo y salarios.** El crecimiento salarial y la seguridad laboral no se comparten equitativamente entre industrias y niveles de ingresos, lo que afecta cuán seguros se sienten los diferentes hogares sobre los próximos meses.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## Cómo es "optar por opciones más económicas"

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: Optar por opciones más económicas no significa necesariamente que la gente deje de comprar.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: Significa que cambian cómo compran.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: Los comportamientos comunes incluyen:

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - Elegir marcas de la tienda en lugar de marcas reconocidas

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - Desplazar las compras hacia minoristas de descuento, clubes de almacenamiento y cadenas de precios rebajados

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - Comprar tamaños de paquete más pequeños o menos artículos por viaje

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - Utilizar planes de compra ahora y paga después, cupones y recompensas de lealtad de forma más activa

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - Retrasar compras más grandes como muebles o electrónica hasta que aparezcan promociones

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, los compradores de mayores ingresos son más propensos a seguir comprando bienes y experiencias prémium, lo que ayuda a explicar por qué algunos negocios de lujo y relacionados con los viajes informan una demanda constante mientras que algunos vendedores masivos describen a un cliente más cauteloso.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## Leyendo las encuestas de confianza

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: Las encuestas de confianza y sentimiento del consumidor, incluidas las lecturas ampliamente seguidas de The Conference Board y la Universidad de Michigan, son útiles pero imperfectas.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: Sus cifras principales pueden ocultar diferencias importantes por debajo.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: Al observar un nuevo informe, ayuda verificar:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **Desgloses por ingresos y edad.** ¿Suenan los encuestados de mayores ingresos notablemente más optimistas que los demás?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Expectativas versus condiciones actuales.** Una brecha entre cómo la gente ve el presente y lo que espera para los próximos seis meses puede indicar preocupación por el empleo o los precios.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **Intenciones de gasto.** Los planes para compras importantes, vacaciones y presupuestos navideños ofrecen pistas sobre la temporada que se avecina.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **Expectativas de inflación.** Si los hogares esperan que los precios sigan subiendo, pueden recortar gastos antes.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: También vale la pena recordar que lo que la gente dice y lo que hace pueden diferir.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: El sentimiento es una señal, no una garantía, y los datos de gasto de los minoristas y los informes gubernamentales proporcionan una comprobación de la realidad necesaria.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## Lo que los minoristas dicen a los inversores

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: Las llamadas de ganancias y las actualizaciones de las empresas son una de las mejores ventanas en tiempo real hacia la división.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: Al leerlos, preste atención a los temas recurrentes en lugar de a cualquier cotización individual:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Los minoristas enfocados en el valor** a menudo destacan las ganancias de tráfico a medida que los compradores buscan precios más bajos.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Los minoristas de nivel medio y estilo de grandes almacenes** pueden hablar de una mayor actividad promocional y una planificación de inventario más ajustada.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Las empresas prémium y orientadas a la experiencia** pueden señalar una demanda resiliente por parte de los clientes adinerados.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **El lenguaje de orientación** como "cauteloso", "selectivo" o "buscador de valor" tiende a aparecer cuando los gerentes esperan que los clientes sigan examinando los precios.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Los minoristas también revelan sus expectativas a través de planes de contratación.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Los anuncios de contratación estacional, en particular, indican cuán seguras se sienten las empresas sobre la demanda navideña.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## Lo que podría significar para el comercio minorista, el empleo y el crecimiento

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Comercio minorista.** Un consumidor de dos velocidades puede producir una temporada navideña que se ve bien en dólares totales pero desigual por debajo.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: **Empleo.** Los empleadores de comercio minorista, hostelería y logística ajustan el personal para que coincida con la demanda.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: Si los compradores cautelosos recortan más de lo esperado, la contratación podría desacelerarse, especialmente en los sectores que atienden a clientes de ingresos medios.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Por otro lado, el gasto constante en la cima puede ayudar a amortiguar el mercado laboral.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: **Crecimiento.** Debido a que los adinerados representan una gran parte del consumo total, el gasto fuerte en la cima puede mantener a flote el crecimiento general por un tiempo.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: El riesgo es la concentración: si ese grupo se retrae, tal vez debido a una caída en los precios de los activos, hay menos gasto de base amplia para tomar su lugar.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: Por el contrario, si la inflación continúa enfriándose y los salarios siguen subiendo, la presión sobre el resto de los hogares podría disminuir y la brecha podría reducirse.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.

segments.tr: ## Conclusiones prácticas para los hogares

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: Independientemente del lado de la división en el que caiga un hogar, la temporada navideña es un buen momento para planificar con cuidado.

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Establecer un presupuesto firme para regalos antes de comprar, comparar precios, verificar las políticas de devolución y evitar deudas que persistan en el año nuevo puede hacer que la temporada sea menos estresante.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Los hogares con espacio adicional en sus presupuestos también pueden considerar apoyar a los negocios locales, que a menudo sienten primero los efectos de los hábitos cambiantes de los consumidores.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: La historia de la economía navideña de 2026 no es simplemente "fuerte" o "débil".

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: Es una historia de diferentes experiencias bajo las mismas cifras principales.

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: Observar cómo se alinean la confianza, los comentarios de los minoristas y los datos de gasto duros dará la imagen más clara de si las dos velocidades convergen o se separan aún más a medida que comienza el año nuevo.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Observar cómo se alinean la confianza, los comentarios de los minoristas y los datos de gasto duros ofrecerá la imagen más clara de si las dos velocidades convergen o se separan aún más a medida que comience el nuevo año.

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: مع اقتراب موسم تسوق العطلات، يبدو المستهلك الأمريكي أقل شبهاً بقصة واحدة وأكثر شبهاً بقصتين.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: حافظت الأسر في الشريحة العليا من مقياس الدخل بشكل عام على إنفاقها على السفر، وتناول الطعام في الخارج، والمشتريات باهظة الثمن.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: في المقابل، تتسم العديد من الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط بانتقائية أكبر: حيث تتحول إلى العلامات التجارية الأرخص، وتنتظر التخفيضات، وتخفض النفقات الإضافية غير الضرورية.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يصف الاقتصاديون هذا النمط بأنه مستهلك "ذو سرعتين" أو "على شكل حرف K"، وهذا مهم لأن الإنفاق الاستهلاكي يشكل نحو ثلثي الاقتصاد الأمريكي.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: تبحث هذه المقالة في سبب ظهور هذا الانقسام، وما يجب مراقبته في استطلاعات الثقة وتعليقات تجار التجزئة، وما يمكن أن يعنيه ذلك لتجارة التجزئة، والوظائف، والنمو.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## لماذا يتباعد الإنفاق

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: تميل عدة قوى إلى دفع الأسر في اتجاهات مختلفة في نفس الوقت.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **قيم الأصول ووسائد المدخرات.** الأسر التي تمتلك أسهماً، أو منازل، أو أصولاً أخرى، والتي قامت بتكوين مدخرات في السنوات الأخيرة، غالباً ما تشعر بثروة أكبر وأمان أكثر. يدعم هذا الشعور الإنفاق حتى عندما تكون الأسعار مرتفعة.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **تكاليف المعيشة اليومية تأخذ حصة أكبر بالنسبة لبعض الفئات.** تستهلك البقالة، والإيجار، والتأمين، والمرافق حصة أكبر من الميزانية للأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط. عندما ترتفع هذه التكاليف بشكل أسرع من الرواتب، يتبقى القليل لأي شيء آخر.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **الاقتراض أصبح أكثر تكلفة.** تجعل أسعار الفائدة المرتفعة أرصدة بطاقات الائتمان، وتقروض السيارات، وتكاليف التمويل أثقل على الأسر التي تعتمد على الاقتراض لتخفيف ميزانياتها.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **اختلافات الوظائف والأجور.** لا يتم توزيع نمو الأجور والأمان الوظيفي بالتساوي عبر القطاعات ومستويات الدخل، مما يؤثر على مدى ثقة الأسر المختلفة بشأن الأشهر القادمة.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## كيف يبدو "التداول نحو الأقل"

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: لا يعني التداول نحو الأقل بالضرورة أن يتوقف الناس عن التسوق.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: بل يعني أنهم يغيرون طريقة تسوقهم.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: تشمل السلوكيات الشائعة ما يلي:

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - اختيار العلامات التجارية للمتاجر بدلاً من العلامات التجارية الشهيرة

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - تحويل المشتريات نحو متاجر التجزئة المخفضة، ونوادي المستودعات، وسلاسل الأسعار المخفضة

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - شراء عبوات أصغر حجماً أو سلعاً أقل لكل رحلة تسوق

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - استخدام خطط الشراء الآن والدفع لاحقاً، والقسائم، ومكافآت الولاء بشكل أكثر نشاطاً

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - تأخير المشتريات الكبيرة مثل الأثاث أو الأجهزة الإلكترونية حتى تظهر العروض الترويجية

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: وفي الوقت نفسه، يُرجح أن يستمر المتسوقون ذوو الدخل المرتفع في شراء السلع والتجارب المميزة، مما يساعد في تفسير سبب إبلاغ بعض الشركات الفاخرة والمرتبطة بالسفر عن طلب مستقر بينما يصف بعض بائع السوق الجماعي عميلاً أكثر حذراً.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## قراءة استطلاعات الثقة

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: تعد استطلاعات ثقة المستهلك ومعنوياته، بما في ذلك القراءات التي تتم متابعتها على نطاق واسع من قبل مجلس المؤتمرات وجامعة ميشيغان، مفيدة ولكنها غير مثالية.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تخفي أرقامها الرئيسية اختلافات مهمة كامنة تحتها.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: عند النظر إلى إصدار جديد، يساعد التحقق من:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **التفاصيل حسب الدخل والعمر.** هل يبدو المستجيبون ذوو الدخل المرتفع أكثر تفاؤلاً بشكل ملحوظ من الآخرين؟

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **التوقعات مقابل الظروف الحالية.** الفجوة بين نظرة الناس للحاضر وما يتوقعونه للأشهر الستة القادمة يمكن أن تشير إلى القلق بشأن الوظائف أو الأسعار.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **نوايا الإنفاق.** تقدم خطط المشتريات الكبرى، والعطلات، وميزانيات العطلات أدلة حول الموسم القادم.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **توقعات التضخم.** إذا توقعت الأسر أن تستمر الأسعار في الارتفاع، فقد تتراجع في وقت أقرب.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: تجدر الإشارة أيضاً إلى أن ما يقوله الناس وما يفعلونه قد يختلف.

fr.title: Un consommateur à deux vitesses : ce que la divergence des dépenses par revenu révèle sur l'économie à l'approche des fêtes

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: À l'approche de la saison des achats des fêtes, le consommateur américain ressemble moins à une histoire unique qu'à deux histoires distinctes.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: Les ménages situés dans la tranche supérieure des revenus ont généralement maintenu leurs dépenses en matière de voyages, de sorties au restaurant et d'achats importants.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: En revanche, de nombreuses familles à revenus faibles et moyens se montrent plus sélectives : elles se tournent vers des marques moins chères, attendent les soldes et réduisent les dépenses discrétionnaires.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Les économistes décrivent souvent ce modèle comme un consommateur « à deux vitesses » ou « en forme de K », et cela est important car les dépenses de consommation représentent environ les deux tiers de l'activité économique des États-Unis.

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: activité économique.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: Cet article examine pourquoi cette fracture est apparue, ce qu'il faut surveiller dans les enquêtes de confiance et les commentaires des détaillants, et ce que cela pourrait signifier pour le commerce de détail, l'emploi et la croissance.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils financiers.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les dépenses divergent

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: Plusieurs forces tendent à pousser les ménages dans des directions différentes en même temps.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **Valeurs des actifs et coussins d'épargne.** Les ménages qui possèdent des actions, des logements ou d'autres actifs, et qui ont constitué une épargne ces dernières années, se sentent souvent plus riches et plus en sécurité. Ce sentiment soutient les dépenses même lorsque les prix sont élevés.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **Les coûts quotidiens pèsent plus lourd pour certains.** L'épicerie, le loyer, l'assurance et les services publics consomment une part plus importante du budget des familles à revenus faibles et moyens. Lorsque ces coûts augmentent plus vite que les salaires, il reste moins pour tout le reste.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **L'emprunt est plus coûteux.** Des taux d'intérêt plus élevés rendent les soldes de cartes de crédit, les prêts automobiles et les coûts de financement plus lourds pour les ménages qui dépendent de l'emprunt pour équilibrer leur budget.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Différences d'emploi et de salaire.** La croissance des salaires et la sécurité de l'emploi ne sont pas réparties de manière égale entre les secteurs et les niveaux de revenu, ce qui affecte la confiance des différents ménages quant aux mois à venir.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## À quoi ressemble la « descente en gamme »

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: La descente en gamme ne signifie pas nécessairement que les gens arrêtent de faire des achats.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: Cela signifie qu'ils changent leur façon de faire leurs achats.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: Les comportements courants incluent :

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - Choisir les marques de distributeur plutôt que les grandes marques

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - Déplacer les achats vers les détaillants à bas prix, les clubs-entrepôts et les chaînes de déstockage

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - Acheter des formats plus petits ou moins d'articles par visite

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - Utiliser plus activement les plans d'achat immédiat et de paiement différé, les coupons et les récompenses de fidélité

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - Reporter les achats plus importants tels que les meubles ou l'électronique jusqu'à l'apparition de promotions

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, les acheteurs à revenus plus élevés sont plus susceptibles de continuer à acheter des produits et des expériences haut de gamme, ce qui explique pourquoi certaines entreprises de luxe et liées au voyage signalent une demande stable alors que certains vendeurs grand public décrivent un client plus prudent.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## Lire les enquêtes de confiance

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes sur la confiance et le sentiment des consommateurs, y compris les lectures largement suivies du Conference Board et de l'Université du Michigan, sont utiles mais imparfaites.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: Leurs chiffres principaux peuvent masquer des différences importantes en dessous.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: Lorsqu'on examine une nouvelle publication, il est utile de vérifier :

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **Répartitions par revenu et par âge.** Les répondants à revenus plus élevés semblent-ils nettement plus optimistes que les autres ?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Attentes par rapport aux conditions actuelles.** Un écart entre la façon dont les gens perçoivent le présent et ce qu'ils attendent pour les six prochains mois peut signaler une inquiétude concernant l'emploi ou les prix.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **Intentions de dépenses.** Les plans pour les achats importants, les vacances et les budgets des fêtes offrent des indices sur la saison à venir.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **Attentes en matière d'inflation.** Si les ménages s'attendent à ce que les prix continuent d'augmenter, ils pourraient se retirer plus tôt.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: Il est également utile de se rappeler que ce que les gens disent et ce qu'ils font peut différer.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: Le sentiment est un signal, pas une garantie, et les données sur les dépenses provenant des détaillants et des rapports gouvernementaux fournissent une vérification nécessaire de la réalité.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## Ce que les détaillants disent aux investisseurs

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: Les appels sur les résultats et les mises à jour des entreprises sont l'une des meilleures fenêtres en temps réel sur cette fracture.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: Lorsque vous les lisez, soyez attentif aux thèmes récurrents plutôt qu'à une citation isolée :

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Les détaillants axés sur la valeur** soulignent souvent des gains de trafic alors que les acheteurs recherchent des prix plus bas.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Les détaillants de milieu de gamme et de type grands magasins** peuvent parler d'une activité promotionnelle accrue et d'une planification des stocks plus serrée.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Les entreprises haut de gamme et axées sur l'expérience** peuvent souligner une demande résiliente de la part des clients aisés.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **Le langage d'orientation** tel que "prudent", "sélectif" ou "à la recherche de valeur" a tendance à apparaître lorsque les gestionnaires s'attendent à ce que les clients continuent d'examiner les prix de près.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Les détaillants révèlent également leurs attentes par le biais de plans d'embauche.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Les annonces d'embauche saisonnière, en particulier, indiquent à quel point les entreprises sont confiantes quant à la demande des fêtes.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour le commerce de détail, l'emploi et la croissance

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Commerce de détail.** Un consommateur à deux vitesses peut produire une saison des fêtes qui semble correcte en dollars totaux mais inégale en dessous.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: Certaines catégories et tranches de prix peuvent surperformer tandis que d'autres dépendent fortement des remises, ce qui peut réduire les marges bénéficiaires même lorsque les ventes se maintiennent.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **Emploi.** Les employeurs du commerce de détail, de l'hôtellerie et de la logistique ajustent leurs effectifs pour correspondre à la demande.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Si les acheteurs prudents réduisent leurs dépenses plus que prévu, l'embauche pourrait ralentir, en particulier dans les secteurs desservant les clients à revenus moyens.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: D'un autre côté, des dépenses stables au sommet peuvent aider à amortir le marché du travail.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **Croissance.** Parce que les personnes aisées représentent une grande part de la consommation totale, des dépenses fortes au sommet peuvent maintenir la croissance globale à flot pendant un certain temps.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: Le risque est la concentration : si ce groupe se retire, peut-être en raison d'une baisse des prix des actifs, il y a moins de dépenses généralisées pour prendre le relais.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: Inversement, si l'inflation continue de se calmer et que les salaires continuent d'augmenter, la pression sur le reste des ménages pourrait s'atténuer et l'écart pourrait se réduire.

segments.tr: ## Signaux à surveiller jusqu'à la fin de l'année

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## Points à retenir pratiques pour les ménages

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Quel que soit le côté de la fracture où se trouve un ménage, la saison des fêtes est un bon moment pour planifier soigneusement.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Fixer un budget cadeau ferme avant de faire des achats, comparer les prix, vérifier les politiques de retour et éviter les dettes qui persisteront dans la nouvelle année peut rendre la saison moins stressante.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: Les ménages ayant une marge de manœuvre dans leur budget peuvent également envisager de soutenir les entreprises locales, qui ressentent souvent les effets des changements d'habitudes de consommation en premier.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: L'histoire de l'économie des fêtes de 2026 n'est pas simplement "forte" ou "faible".

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: C'est une histoire d'expériences différentes sous les mêmes chiffres principaux.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Observer comment la confiance, les commentaires des détaillants et les données réelles sur les dépenses s'alignent donnera l'image la plus claire de savoir si les deux vitesses convergent ou s'écartent davantage à mesure que la nouvelle année commence.

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
