segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **Intenções de gastos.** Planos para grandes compras, férias e orçamentos de fim de ano oferecem pistas sobre a temporada que se avizinha.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **Expectativas de inflação.** Se as famílias esperam que os preços continuem subindo, elas podem recuar mais cedo.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: Também vale a lembrar que o que as pessoas dizem e o que elas fazem podem diferir.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: O sentimento é um sinal, não uma garantia, e os dados de gastos de varejistas e relatórios governamentais fornecem uma verificação de realidade necessária.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## O que os varejistas estão dizendo aos investidores

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: As teleconferências de resultados e atualizações de empresas são uma das melhores janelas em tempo real para observar essa divisão.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: Ao lê-las, fique atento a temas recorrentes em vez de a qualquer citação isolada:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Varejistas focados em valor** frequentemente destacam ganhos de tráfego à medida que os compradores buscam preços mais baixos.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Varejistas de nível intermediário e estilo de loja de departamentos** podem falar sobre maior atividade promocional e planejamento de estoque mais apertado.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Empresas focadas em produtos premium e experiências** podem apontar para uma demanda resiliente de clientes afluentes.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **Linguagem de orientações** como "cauteloso", "seletivo" ou "em busca de valor" tende a aparecer quando os gestores esperam que os clientes continuem examinando os preços.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Os varejistas também revelam suas expectativas por meio de planos de contratação.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Os anúncios de contratação sazonal, em particular, indicam o nível de confiança das empresas na demanda de fim de ano.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## O que isso pode significar para o varejo, empregos e crescimento

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Varejo.** Um consumidor de duas velocidades pode produzir uma temporada de festas que parece boa em termos de dólares totais, mas desigual por dentro.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: Algumas categorias e faixas de preço podem ter um desempenho superior, enquanto outras dependem fortemente de descontos, o que pode espremer as margens de lucro mesmo quando as vendas se mantêm.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **Empregos.** Os empregadores de varejo, hospitalidade e logística ajustam seus quadros de funcionários para corresponder à demanda.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Se os compradores cautelosos cortarem gastos mais do que o esperado, as contratações podem desacelerar, especialmente em setores que atendem a clientes de média renda.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: Por outro lado, o gasto constante no topo pode ajudar a amortecer o mercado de trabalho.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **Crescimento.** Como os afluentes respondem por uma grande parcela do consumo total, os gastos fortes no topo podem manter o crescimento geral à tona por um tempo.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: O risco é a concentração: se esse grupo recuar, talvez devido a uma queda nos preços dos ativos, haverá menos gastos generalizados para ocupar o seu lugar.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: Por outro lado, se a inflação continuar a arrefecer e os salários continuarem subindo, a pressão sobre o restante das famílias poderá diminuir e a lacuna poderá se estreitar.

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## Sinais que vale a pena observar até o final do ano

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - Relatórios mensais de vendas no varejo, incluindo vendas do grupo de controle que alimentam as estimativas do PIB

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - Tendências de inadimplência e saldo de cartões de crédito do Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York e outras fontes

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - Pedidos semanais de seguro-desemprego e relatórios mensais de folha de pagamento

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - Leituras de inflação, particularmente para alimentos, moradia e serviços

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - Previsões de vendas de fim de ano de grupos da indústria, comparadas com os resultados reais em dezembro e janeiro

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## Conclusões práticas para as famílias

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Independentemente do lado da divisão em que uma família se encontre, a temporada de festas é um bom momento para planejar com cuidado.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Definir um orçamento firme para presentes antes de ir às compras, comparar preços, verificar políticas de devolução e evitar dívidas que se arrastem para o ano novo podem tornar a temporada menos estressante.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: As famílias com margem extra em seus orçamentos também podem considerar apoiar negócios locais, que frequentemente sentem primeiro os efeitos da mudança nos hábitos dos consumidores.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: A história da economia de festas de 2026 não é simplesmente "forte" ou "fraca".

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: É uma história de experiências diferentes sob os mesmos números principais.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Observar como a confiança, os comentários dos varejistas e os dados sólidos de gastos se alinham dará a imagem mais clara de se as duas velocidades convergem ou se afastam ainda mais à medida que o ano novo começa.

in.title: Konsumen Dua Kecepatan: Apa Arti Perbedaan Pengeluaran Berdasarkan Pendapatan bagi Ekonomi Menjelang Liburan

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: Menjelang musim belanja liburan, konsumen Amerika terlihat bukan sebagai satu cerita tunggal, melainkan dua cerita.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga di tingkat pendapatan atas umumnya tetap mempertahankan pengeluaran untuk perjalanan, makan di luar, dan pembelian barang-barang bernilai besar.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, banyak keluarga berpenghasilan rendah dan menengah menjadi lebih selektif: beralih ke merek yang lebih murah, menunggu diskon, dan memangkas pengeluaran tambahan yang tidak penting.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Para ekonom sering menggambarkan pola ini sebagai konsumen "dua kecepatan" atau "berbentuk K", dan hal ini penting karena pengeluaran konsumen mencakup sekitar dua pertiga dari aktivitas

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: ekonomi AS.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: Artikel ini membahas mengapa perpecahan ini muncul, apa yang perlu diperhatikan dalam survei kepercayaan dan komentar pengecer, serta apa artinya bagi ritel, lapangan kerja, dan pertumbuhan.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## Mengapa pengeluaran berbeda

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: Beberapa kekuatan cenderung mendorong rumah tangga ke arah yang berbeda pada saat yang bersamaan.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **Nilai aset dan bantalan tabungan.** Rumah tangga yang memiliki saham, rumah, atau aset lain, dan yang telah membangun tabungan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, sering kali merasa lebih kaya dan lebih aman. Perasaan itu mendukung pengeluaran bahkan ketika harga tinggi.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **Biaya sehari-hari membebani sebagian orang lebih besar.** Bahan makanan, sewa, asuransi, dan utilitas menghabiskan porsi anggaran yang lebih besar bagi keluarga berpenghasilan rendah dan menengah. Ketika biaya-biaya tersebut naik lebih cepat daripada gaji, hanya sedikit yang tersisa untuk kebutuhan lainnya.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **Pinjaman lebih mahal.** Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi membuat saldo kartu kredit, pinjaman mobil, dan biaya pembiayaan menjadi lebih berat bagi rumah tangga yang bergantung pada pinjaman untuk menyeimbangkan anggaran mereka.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Perbedaan pekerjaan dan upah.** Pertumbuhan upah dan keamanan kerja tidak terbagi secara merata di seluruh industri dan tingkat pendapatan, yang memengaruhi seberapa percaya diri rumah tangga yang berbeda tentang bulan-bulan mendatang.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## Seperti apa "beralih ke yang lebih murah" itu

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: Beralih ke yang lebih murah tidak berarti orang berhenti berbelanja.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: Itu berarti mereka mengubah cara mereka berbelanja.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: Perilaku umum meliputi:

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - Memilih merek toko daripada merek ternama

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - Mengalihkan pembelian ke pengecer diskon, klub gudang, dan jaringan harga murah

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - Membeli kemasan yang lebih kecil atau lebih sedikit barang per kunjungan

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - Menggunakan rencana beli sekarang bayar nanti, kupon, dan imbalan loyalitas secara lebih aktif

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - Menunda pembelian yang lebih besar seperti furnitur atau elektronik hingga promosi muncul

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, pembeli berpenghasilan lebih tinggi lebih cenderung terus membeli barang dan pengalaman premium, yang membantu menjelaskan mengapa beberapa bisnis barang mewah dan terkait perjalanan melaporkan permintaan yang stabil sementara beberapa penjual pasar massal menggambarkan pelanggan yang lebih berhati-hati.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## Membaca survei kepercayaan

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: Survei kepercayaan dan sentimen konsumen, termasuk pembacaan yang banyak diikuti dari The Conference Board dan University of Michigan, berguna tetapi tidak sempurna.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: Angka utama mereka dapat menyembunyikan perbedaan penting di bawahnya.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: Saat melihat rilis baru, ada baiknya untuk memeriksa:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **Rincian berdasarkan pendapatan dan usia.** Apakah responden berpenghasilan lebih tinggi terdengar jauh lebih optimis daripada yang lain?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Ekspektasi versus kondisi saat ini.** Kesenjangan antara bagaimana orang memandang masa kini dan apa yang mereka harapkan untuk enam bulan ke depan dapat menandakan kekhawatiran tentang pekerjaan atau harga.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **Niat belanja.** Rencana untuk pembelian besar, liburan, dan anggaran liburan menawarkan petunjuk tentang musim mendatang.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **Ekspektasi inflasi.** Jika rumah tangga memperkirakan harga akan terus naik, mereka mungkin menarik diri lebih cepat.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: Perlu juga diingat bahwa apa yang dikatakan orang dan apa yang mereka lakukan bisa berbeda.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: Sentimen adalah sinyal, bukan jaminan, dan data pengeluaran dari pengecer serta laporan pemerintah memberikan pemeriksaan realitas yang diperlukan.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dikatakan pengecer kepada investor

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: Panggilan pendapatan dan pembaruan perusahaan adalah salah satu jendela waktu nyata terbaik ke dalam perpecahan ini.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: Saat membacanya, dengarkan tema yang berulang daripada kutipan tunggal apa pun:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Pengecer yang berfokus pada nilai** sering menyoroti peningkatan lalu lintas saat pembeli mencari harga yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Pengecer tingkat menengah dan gaya departemen store** mungkin berbicara tentang lebih banyak aktivitas promosi dan perencanaan inventaris yang lebih ketat.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Bisnis premium dan berorientasi pengalaman** mungkin menunjukkan permintaan yang tangguh dari pelanggan kaya.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **Bahasa panduan** seperti "berhati-hati," "selektif," atau "mencari nilai" cenderung muncul ketika manajer memperkirakan pelanggan akan terus meneliti harga.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Pengecer juga mengungkapkan ekspektasi mereka melalui rencana perekrutan.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Pengumuman perekrutan musiman, khususnya, menunjukkan seberapa percaya diri perusahaan terhadap permintaan liburan.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi ritel, lapangan kerja, dan pertumbuhan

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Ritel.** Konsumen dua kecepatan dapat menghasilkan musim liburan yang terlihat baik dalam total dolar tetapi tidak merata di bawahnya.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: Beberapa kategori dan tingkat harga mungkin berkinerja lebih baik sementara yang lain sangat bergantung pada diskon, yang dapat menekan margin keuntungan bahkan ketika penjualan bertahan.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **Pekerjaan.** Pengusaha ritel, perhotelan, dan logistik menyesuaikan staf untuk mencocokkan permintaan.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Jika pembeli yang berhati-hati memangkas pengeluaran lebih dari yang diharapkan, perekrutan bisa melambat, terutama di sektor yang melayani pelanggan berpenghasilan menengah.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: Di sisi lain, pengeluaran yang stabil di tingkat atas dapat membantu melindungi pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **Pertumbuhan.** Karena kelompok kaya menyumbang sebagian besar dari total konsumsi, pengeluaran yang kuat di tingkat atas dapat menjaga pertumbuhan keseluruhan tetap bertahan untuk sementara waktu.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: Risikonya adalah konsentrasi: jika kelompok itu menarik diri, mungkin karena penurunan harga aset, ada lebih sedikit pengeluaran berbasis luas untuk menggantikannya.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, jika inflasi terus mendingin dan upah terus naik, tekanan pada rumah tangga lainnya dapat mereda dan kesenjangan dapat menyempit.

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## Sinyal yang layak diperhatikan hingga akhir tahun

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - Laporan penjualan ritel bulanan, termasuk penjualan kelompok kontrol yang masuk ke dalam estimasi PDB

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - Tren tunggakan dan saldo kartu kredit dari Federal Reserve Bank of New York dan sumber lainnya

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - Klaim pengangguran mingguan dan laporan penggajian bulanan

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - Pembacaan inflasi, terutama untuk makanan, perumahan, dan layanan

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - Prakiraan penjualan liburan dari kelompok industri, dibandingkan dengan hasil aktual pada bulan Desember dan Januari

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## Pelajaran praktis untuk rumah tangga

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Di sisi mana pun sebuah rumah tangga berada, musim liburan adalah saat yang tepat untuk merencanakan dengan cermat.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Menetapkan anggaran hadiah yang tegas sebelum berbelanja, membandingkan harga, memeriksa kebijakan pengembalian, dan menghindari utang yang akan bertahan hingga tahun baru dapat membuat musim ini tidak terlalu menegangkan.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga dengan ruang ekstra dalam anggaran mereka juga dapat mempertimbangkan untuk mendukung bisnis lokal, yang sering kali merasakan dampak perubahan kebiasaan konsumen terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: Cerita tentang ekonomi liburan 2026 bukan sekadar "kuat" atau "lemah."

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: Ini adalah cerita tentang pengalaman yang berbeda di bawah angka utama yang sama.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Mengamati bagaimana kepercayaan, komentar pengecer, dan data pengeluaran yang keras selaras akan memberikan gambaran paling jelas tentang apakah kedua kecepatan tersebut bertemu atau semakin menjauh saat tahun baru dimulai.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## なぜ支出が乖離しているのか

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: いくつかの力が、同時に世帯を異なる方向に押しやる傾向があります。

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **資産価値と貯蓄のクッション。** 株式、住宅、その他の資産を保有し、近年貯蓄を積み上げてきた世帯は、多くの場合、より裕福で安全だと感じています。その感覚が、物価が高騰していても支出を支えています。

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **日々のコストが一部の人々にとって大きな負担となっている。** 食料品、家賃、保険、光熱費は、低・中所得層の家計においてより大きな割合を占めています。これらのコストが給与よりも速く上昇すると、他のことに回せるお金が少なくなります。

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **借入コストの上昇。** 金利の上昇により、家計のやりくりを借入に頼っている世帯にとって、クレジットカードの残高、自動車ローン、融資コストの負担が重くなっています。

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **雇用と賃金の格差。** 賃金の上昇と雇用の安定は、業界や所得水準によって均等に分配されておらず、それが今後の数ヶ月間に対する世帯の自信に影響を与えています。

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## 「トレードダウン（格下げ）」とはどのようなものか

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: トレードダウンとは、必ずしも買い物をやめることを意味するわけではありません。

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: それは買い物の仕方を変えることを意味します。

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: 一般的な行動には以下が含まれます：

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - ナショナルブランドよりもストアブランド（プライベートブランド）を選ぶ

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - ディスカウント小売店、会員制倉庫型店舗、オフプライスチェーンへ購入先をシフトする

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - 1回の買い物あたりの購入点数を減らす、または小容量のパッケージを買う

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - 「今買って後で払う（BNPL）」プラン、クーポン、ロイヤリティ報酬をより積極的に利用する

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - 家具や家電などの大型購入を、プロモーションが出るまで延期する

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: 一方、高所得層の買い物客は、プレミアムな商品や体験を買い続ける可能性が高く、これが一部の高級品や旅行関連企業が堅調な需要を報告する一方で、大衆向け販売業者がより慎重な顧客について言及する理由を説明しています。

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## 信頼感調査の読み方

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: コンファレンス・ボードやミシガン大学による広く注目されている調査を含む、消費者信頼感やセンチメント調査は有用ですが、完璧ではありません。

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: そのヘッドラインの数字は、その裏にある重要な違いを隠してしまう可能性があります。

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: 新しいデータが発表されたときは、以下を確認することが役立ちます：

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **所得や年齢別の内訳。** 高所得層の回答者は、他の層よりも明らかに楽観的か？

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **期待と現状の比較。** 人々が現在をどう見ているかと、今後6ヶ月に何を期待しているかのギャップは、雇用や物価に対する懸念を示唆している可能性がある。

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **支出意向。** 主要な購入、休暇、ホリデー予算の計画は、これからのシーズンについてのヒントを提供してくれる。

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **インフレ期待。** 世帯が物価の上昇が続くと予想すれば、より早く支出を控える可能性がある。

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: また、人々が言うことと実際に行うことは異なる可能性があることを覚えておくことも重要です。

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: センチメントはシグナルであり、保証ではありません。小売業者や政府の報告書からの支出データが、必要な現実確認を提供します。

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## 小売業者が投資家に伝えていること

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: 決算説明会や企業の最新情報は、この分断をリアルタイムで知るための最良の窓口の一つです。

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: それらを読むときは、単一の引用ではなく、繰り返されるテーマに耳を傾けてください：

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **価値重視の小売業者**は、買い物客がより低い価格を求めているため、客数の増加を強調することが多い。

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **中価格帯や百貨店スタイルの小売業者**は、より多くの販促活動や、より厳格な在庫計画について語るかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **プレミアムや体験志向の企業**は、裕福な顧客からの回復力のある需要を指摘するかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - 「慎重な（cautious）」、「選択的な（choiceful）」、「価値を求める（value-seeking）」といった**ガイダンスの言葉**は、経営陣が顧客が価格を精査し続けると予想しているときに現れる傾向がある。

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: 小売業者はまた、採用計画を通じて期待を明らかにします。

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: 特に季節的な採用の発表は、企業がホリデー需要に対してどれだけ自信を持っているかを示しています。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## それが小売、雇用、成長にとって何を意味するのか

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **小売。** 二極化した消費者は、総額では問題ないように見えても、その内実は不均一なホリデーシーズンを生み出す可能性があります。

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: 一部のカテゴリーや価格帯は好調でも、他は割引に大きく依存する可能性があり、売上が維持されていても利益率を圧迫する可能性があります。

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **雇用。** 小売、ホスピタリティ、物流の雇用主は、需要に合わせて人員配置を調整します。

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: 慎重な買い物客が予想以上に支出を削減すれば、特に中所得層の顧客にサービスを提供するセクターでは、採用が鈍化する可能性があります。

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: 一方で、上位層での安定した支出は、労働市場を支える助けとなる可能性があります。

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **成長。** 富裕層が総消費の大きな割合を占めているため、上位層での強力な支出は、しばらくの間、全体的な成長を維持することができます。

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: リスクは集中です。もしそのグループが資産価格の下落などを理由に支出を控えた場合、それに代わる広範な支出が不足します。

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: 逆に、インフレが沈静化し続け、賃金が上昇し続ければ、残りの世帯への圧力は緩和され、格差は縮小する可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## 年末に向けて注目すべきシグナル

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - 月次の小売売上高報告（GDP予測に反映されるコントロールグループ売上高を含む）

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - ニューヨーク連邦準備銀行やその他の情報源による、延滞率およびクレジットカード残高の傾向

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - 週次の失業保険申請件数および月次の雇用統計

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - インフレ指標（特に食品、住宅、サービス）

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - 業界団体によるホリデー売上予測と、12月および1月の実績との比較

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## 世帯のための実践的なヒント

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: どの層に属しているかに関わらず、ホリデーシーズンは慎重に計画を立てる良い機会です。

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: 買い物をする前にしっかりとしたギフト予算を設定し、価格を比較し、返品ポリシーを確認し、新しい年に持ち越すような借金を避けることで、シーズンをよりストレスなく過ごすことができます。

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: 家計に余裕がある世帯は、消費習慣の変化の影響を最初に受けやすい地元のビジネスを支援することも検討してみてください。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: 2026年のホリデー経済の物語は、単に「強い」か「弱い」かではありません。

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: それは、同じヘッドラインの数字の下にある、異なる経験の物語です。

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: 信頼感、小売業者のコメント、そして確実な支出データがどのように一致するかを観察することで、新しい年が始まるにつれて、二つの速度が収束するのか、それともさらに乖離するのかについて、最も明確な全体像が得られるでしょう。

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Wertorientierte Einzelhändler** heben oft Verkehrszuwächse hervor, da Käufer nach niedrigeren Preisen suchen.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Einzelhändler im mittleren Segment und Kaufhäuser** sprechen möglicherweise von mehr Werbeaktivitäten und einer strafferen Bestandsplanung.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Premium- und erlebnisorientierte Unternehmen** könnten auf eine widerstandsfähige Nachfrage wohlhabender Kunden hinweisen.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **Leitsprache** wie "vorsichtig", "wählerisch" oder "wertorientiert" taucht tendenziell auf, wenn Manager erwarten, dass Kunden die Preise weiterhin genau prüfen.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler offenbaren ihre Erwartungen auch durch Einstellungspläne.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Insbesondere Ankündigungen für saisonale Einstellungen zeigen, wie zuversichtlich Unternehmen hinsichtlich der Feiertagsnachfrage sind.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## Was das für Einzelhandel, Arbeitsplätze und Wachstum bedeuten könnte

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Einzelhandel.** Ein Konsument mit zwei Geschwindigkeiten kann eine Feiertagssaison hervorbringen, die in Gesamtdollars gut aussieht, aber darunter ungleichmäßig ist.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: Einige Kategorien und Preisklassen können besser abschneiden, während andere stark auf Rabatte angewiesen sind, was die Gewinnspannen schmälern kann, selbst wenn die Umsätze stabil bleiben.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **Arbeitsplätze.** Arbeitgeber im Einzelhandel, im Gastgewerbe und in der Logistik passen die Personalbesetzung an die Nachfrage an.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Wenn vorsichtige Käufer mehr als erwartet kürzen, könnte die Einstellung verlangsamt werden, insbesondere in Sektoren, die Kunden mit mittlerem Einkommen bedienen.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: Andererseits können stetige Ausgaben an der Spitze dazu beitragen, den Arbeitsmarkt zu stützen.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **Wachstum.** Da die Wohlhabenden einen großen Anteil am Gesamtkonsum ausmachen, können starke Ausgaben an der Spitze das Gesamtwachstum eine Zeit lang über Wasser halten.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: Das Risiko ist die Konzentration: Wenn sich diese Gruppe zurückzieht, vielleicht aufgrund eines Falls der Vermögenspreise, gibt es weniger breit angelegte Ausgaben, die an ihre Stelle treten könnten.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: Umgekehrt, wenn die Inflation weiter abkühlt und die Löhne weiter steigen, könnte der Druck auf die übrigen Haushalte nachlassen und die Kluft könnte sich verringern.

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## Signale, die man bis zum Jahresende beobachten sollte

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - Monatliche Einzelhandelsumsatzberichte, einschließlich der Kontrollgruppenumsätze, die in BIP-Schätzungen einfließen

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - Trends bei Zahlungsverzug und Kreditkartensalden von der Federal Reserve Bank of New York und anderen Quellen

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - Wöchentliche Erstanträge auf Arbeitslosenhilfe und monatliche Lohnabrechnungsberichte

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - Inflationswerte, insbesondere für Lebensmittel, Wohnen und Dienstleistungen

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - Prognosen für das Weihnachtsgeschäft von Industriegruppen im Vergleich zu den tatsächlichen Ergebnissen im Dezember und Januar

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## Praktische Erkenntnisse für Haushalte

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Auf welcher Seite der Spaltung ein Haushalt auch steht, die Feiertagssaison ist ein guter Moment, um sorgfältig zu planen.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Das Festlegen eines festen Geschenkbudgets vor dem Einkauf, der Preisvergleich, die Überprüfung der Rückgaberichtlinien und die Vermeidung von Schulden, die bis ins neue Jahr bestehen bleiben, können die Saison weniger stressig machen.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: Haushalte mit zusätzlichem Spielraum in ihren Budgets können auch in Erwägung ziehen, lokale Unternehmen zu unterstützen, die die Auswirkungen sich ändernder Konsumgewohnheiten oft zuerst spüren.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: Die Geschichte der Feiertagswirtschaft 2026 ist nicht einfach "stark" oder "schwach".

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: Es ist eine Geschichte unterschiedlicher Erfahrungen unter denselben Schlagzeilenzahlen.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Die Beobachtung, wie Vertrauen, Kommentare von Einzelhändlern und harte Ausgabendaten übereinstimmen, wird das klarste Bild davon vermitteln, ob die beiden Geschwindigkeiten konvergieren oder weiter auseinanderdriften, wenn das neue Jahr beginnt.

vi.title: Người tiêu dùng hai tốc độ: Sự chi tiêu phân kỳ theo thu nhập nói gì về nền kinh tế khi bước vào mùa lễ hội

segments.src: As the holiday shopping season approaches, the American consumer looks less like a single story and more like two.
segments.tr: Khi mùa mua sắm lễ hội đến gần, người tiêu dùng Mỹ trông ít giống một câu chuyện duy nhất hơn mà giống như hai câu chuyện hơn.

segments.src: Households at the upper end of the income scale have generally kept spending on travel, dining out, and big-ticket purchases.
segments.tr: Các hộ gia đình ở mức thu nhập cao hơn thường duy trì việc chi tiêu cho du lịch, ăn uống ngoài hàng và các giao dịch lớn.

segments.src: Many lower- and middle-income families, by contrast, are being more selective: trading down to cheaper brands, waiting for sales, and trimming discretionary extras.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, nhiều gia đình có thu nhập thấp và trung bình lại tỏ ra có chọn lọc hơn: chuyển sang các thương hiệu rẻ hơn, chờ giảm giá và cắt giảm các khoản chi tiêu không bắt buộc.

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a "two-speed" or "K-shaped" consumer, and it matters because consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế thường mô tả mô hình này là người tiêu dùng "hai tốc độ" hoặc "hình chữ K", và điều đó quan trọng vì chi tiêu tiêu dùng chiếm khoảng 2/3 tổng số của Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: hoạt động kinh tế.

segments.src: This article looks at why the split has emerged, what to watch in confidence surveys and retailer commentary, and what it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth.
segments.tr: Bài viết này xem xét lý do tại sao sự chia rẽ này lại xuất hiện, những điều cần theo dõi trong các cuộc khảo sát niềm tin và bình luận của nhà bán lẻ, cũng như ý nghĩa của nó đối với bán lẻ, việc làm và tăng trưởng.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Đây là thông tin chung, không phải lời khuyên tài chính.

segments.src: ## Why spending is diverging
segments.tr: ## Tại sao chi tiêu đang phân kỳ

segments.src: Several forces tend to push households in different directions at the same time.
segments.tr: Một số lực lượng có xu hướng đẩy các hộ gia đình theo các hướng khác nhau cùng một lúc.

segments.src: - **Asset values and savings cushions.** Households that own stocks, homes, or other assets, and that built up savings in recent years, often feel wealthier and more secure. That feeling supports spending even when prices are elevated.
segments.tr: - **Giá trị tài sản và đệm tiết kiệm.** Các hộ gia đình sở hữu cổ phiếu, nhà cửa hoặc các tài sản khác, và đã tích lũy tiết kiệm trong những năm gần đây, thường cảm thấy giàu có và an toàn hơn. Cảm giác đó hỗ trợ chi tiêu ngay cả khi giá cả tăng cao.

segments.src: - **Everyday costs take a bigger bite for some.** Groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities consume a larger share of the budget for lower- and middle-income families. When those costs rise faster than paychecks, there is less left for anything else.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí hàng ngày chiếm phần lớn hơn đối với một số người.** Tạp hóa, tiền thuê nhà, bảo hiểm và tiện ích tiêu tốn một phần lớn hơn trong ngân sách của các gia đình có thu nhập thấp và trung bình. Khi những chi phí đó tăng nhanh hơn tiền lương, sẽ còn lại ít hơn cho bất cứ thứ gì khác.

segments.src: - **Borrowing is more expensive.** Higher interest rates make credit card balances, auto loans, and financing costs heavier for households that depend on borrowing to smooth their budgets.
segments.tr: - **Việc vay mượn trở nên đắt đỏ hơn.** Lãi suất cao hơn làm cho số dư thẻ tín dụng, khoản vay ô tô và chi phí tài chính trở nên nặng nề hơn đối với các hộ gia đình phụ thuộc vào việc vay mượn để cân đối ngân sách của họ.

segments.src: - **Job and wage differences.** Wage growth and job security are not evenly shared across industries and income levels, which affects how confident different households feel about the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Sự khác biệt về việc làm và tiền lương.** Tăng trưởng tiền lương và an ninh việc làm không được phân bổ đều giữa các ngành và mức thu nhập, điều này ảnh hưởng đến mức độ tự tin của các hộ gia đình khác nhau đối với những tháng sắp tới.

segments.src: ## What "trading down" looks like
segments.tr: ## "Giao dịch xuống" trông như thế nào

segments.src: Trading down does not necessarily mean people stop shopping.
segments.tr: Giao dịch xuống không nhất thiết có nghĩa là mọi người ngừng mua sắm.

segments.src: It means they change how they shop.
segments.tr: Điều đó có nghĩa là họ thay đổi cách mua sắm.

segments.src: Common behaviors include:
segments.tr: Các hành vi phổ biến bao gồm:

segments.src: - Choosing store brands over name brands
segments.tr: - Lựa chọn thương hiệu cửa hàng thay vì thương hiệu nổi tiếng

segments.src: - Shifting purchases toward discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and off-price chains
segments.tr: - Chuyển dịch mua sắm sang các nhà bán lẻ giảm giá, câu lạc bộ kho và các chuỗi giá rẻ

segments.src: - Buying smaller pack sizes or fewer items per trip
segments.tr: - Mua các gói nhỏ hơn hoặc ít mặt hàng hơn cho mỗi chuyến đi

segments.src: - Using buy-now-pay-later plans, coupons, and loyalty rewards more actively
segments.tr: - Sử dụng các kế hoạch mua trước trả sau, phiếu giảm giá và phần thưởng trung thành tích cực hơn

segments.src: - Delaying larger purchases such as furniture or electronics until promotions appear
segments.tr: - Trì hoãn các giao dịch mua lớn hơn như đồ nội thất hoặc thiết bị điện tử cho đến khi có chương trình khuyến mãi

segments.src: Meanwhile, higher-income shoppers are more likely to keep buying premium goods and experiences, which helps explain why some luxury and travel-related businesses report steady demand while some mass-market sellers describe a more cautious customer.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, những người mua sắm có thu nhập cao có nhiều khả năng tiếp tục mua hàng hóa và trải nghiệm cao cấp hơn, điều này giúp giải thích tại sao một số doanh nghiệp xa xỉ và liên quan đến du lịch báo cáo nhu cầu ổn định trong khi một số người bán hàng đại trà mô tả một khách hàng thận trọng hơn.

segments.src: ## Reading the confidence surveys
segments.tr: ## Đọc các cuộc khảo sát niềm tin

segments.src: Consumer confidence and sentiment surveys, including the widely followed readings from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan, are useful but imperfect.
segments.tr: Các cuộc khảo sát niềm tin và tâm lý người tiêu dùng, bao gồm các chỉ số được theo dõi rộng rãi từ The Conference Board và Đại học Michigan, rất hữu ích nhưng chưa hoàn hảo.

segments.src: Their headline numbers can hide important differences underneath.
segments.tr: Các con số tiêu đề của họ có thể ẩn giấu những khác biệt quan trọng bên dưới.

segments.src: When looking at a new release, it helps to check:
segments.tr: Khi xem xét một bản phát hành mới, việc kiểm tra sẽ hữu ích:

segments.src: 1. **Breakdowns by income and age.** Do higher-income respondents sound noticeably more upbeat than others?
segments.tr: 1. **Phân tích theo thu nhập và độ tuổi.** Những người trả lời có thu nhập cao hơn có vẻ lạc quan hơn đáng kể so với những người khác không?

segments.src: 2. **Expectations versus current conditions.** A gap between how people view the present and what they expect for the next six months can signal worry about jobs or prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Kỳ vọng so với điều kiện hiện tại.** Khoảng cách giữa cách mọi người nhìn nhận hiện tại và những gì họ mong đợi trong sáu tháng tới có thể báo hiệu sự lo lắng về việc làm hoặc giá cả.

segments.src: 3. **Spending intentions.** Plans for major purchases, vacations, and holiday budgets offer clues about the season ahead.
segments.tr: 3. **Ý định chi tiêu.** Các kế hoạch mua sắm lớn, kỳ nghỉ và ngân sách kỳ nghỉ cung cấp manh mối về mùa sắp tới.

segments.src: 4. **Inflation expectations.** If households expect prices to keep climbing, they may pull back sooner.
segments.tr: 4. **Kỳ vọng lạm phát.** Nếu các hộ gia đình kỳ vọng giá cả tiếp tục tăng, họ có thể rút lui sớm hơn.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering that what people say and what they do can differ.
segments.tr: Cũng cần nhớ rằng những gì mọi người nói và những gì họ làm có thể khác nhau.

segments.src: Sentiment is a signal, not a guarantee, and spending data from retailers and government reports provide a necessary reality check.
segments.tr: Tâm lý là một tín hiệu, không phải là sự đảm bảo, và dữ liệu chi tiêu từ các nhà bán lẻ và báo cáo của chính phủ cung cấp một sự kiểm tra thực tế cần thiết.

segments.src: ## What retailers are telling investors
segments.tr: ## Những gì các nhà bán lẻ đang nói với các nhà đầu tư

segments.src: Earnings calls and company updates are one of the best real-time windows into the divide.
segments.tr: Các cuộc gọi thu nhập và cập nhật của công ty là một trong những cửa sổ thời gian thực tốt nhất để nhìn vào sự chia rẽ.

segments.src: When reading them, listen for recurring themes rather than any single quote:
segments.tr: Khi đọc chúng, hãy lắng nghe các chủ đề lặp đi lặp lại thay vì bất kỳ trích dẫn đơn lẻ nào:

segments.src: - **Value-focused retailers** often highlight traffic gains as shoppers seek lower prices.
segments.tr: - **Các nhà bán lẻ tập trung vào giá trị** thường nhấn mạnh mức tăng trưởng lưu lượng truy cập khi người mua sắm tìm kiếm giá thấp hơn.

segments.src: - **Mid-tier and department-style retailers** may speak about more promotional activity and tighter inventory planning.
segments.tr: - **Các nhà bán lẻ cấp trung và phong cách bách hóa** có thể nói về hoạt động quảng cáo nhiều hơn và lập kế hoạch hàng tồn kho chặt chẽ hơn.

segments.src: - **Premium and experience-oriented businesses** may point to resilient demand from affluent customers.
segments.tr: - **Các doanh nghiệp cao cấp và định hướng trải nghiệm** có thể chỉ ra nhu cầu kiên cường từ những khách hàng giàu có.

segments.src: - **Guidance language** such as "cautious," "choiceful," or "value-seeking" tends to show up when managers expect customers to keep scrutinizing prices.
segments.tr: - **Ngôn ngữ hướng dẫn** như "thận trọng", "có lựa chọn" hoặc "tìm kiếm giá trị" có xu hướng xuất hiện khi các nhà quản lý kỳ vọng khách hàng tiếp tục xem xét kỹ lưỡng giá cả.

segments.src: Retailers also reveal their expectations through hiring plans.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ cũng tiết lộ kỳ vọng của họ thông qua các kế hoạch tuyển dụng.

segments.src: Seasonal hiring announcements, in particular, indicate how confident companies feel about holiday demand.
segments.tr: Đặc biệt, các thông báo tuyển dụng theo mùa cho biết mức độ tự tin của các công ty về nhu cầu kỳ nghỉ.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for retail, jobs, and growth
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa của nó đối với bán lẻ, việc làm và tăng trưởng

segments.src: **Retail.** A two-speed consumer can produce a holiday season that looks fine in total dollars but uneven underneath.
segments.tr: **Bán lẻ.** Người tiêu dùng hai tốc độ có thể tạo ra một mùa lễ hội trông có vẻ ổn về tổng số đô la nhưng lại không đồng đều bên dưới.

segments.src: Some categories and price tiers may outperform while others rely heavily on discounts, which can squeeze profit margins even when sales hold up.
segments.tr: Một số danh mục và mức giá có thể vượt trội trong khi những danh mục khác phụ thuộc nhiều vào giảm giá, điều này có thể làm giảm tỷ suất lợi nhuận ngay cả khi doanh số giữ vững.

segments.src: **Jobs.** Retail, hospitality, and logistics employers adjust staffing to match demand.
segments.tr: **Việc làm.** Các nhà tuyển dụng bán lẻ, khách sạn và hậu cần điều chỉnh nhânStaff để phù hợp với nhu cầu.

segments.src: If cautious shoppers cut back more than expected, hiring could slow, especially in sectors serving middle-income customers.
segments.tr: Nếu người mua sắm thận trọng cắt giảm nhiều hơn dự kiến, việc làm có thể chậm lại, đặc biệt là trong các lĩnh vực phục vụ khách hàng có thu nhập trung bình.

segments.src: On the other hand, steady spending at the top can help cushion the labor market.
segments.tr: Mặt khác, chi tiêu ổn định ở cấp cao nhất có thể giúp đệm cho thị trường lao động.

segments.src: **Growth.** Because the affluent account for a large share of total consumption, strong spending at the top can keep overall growth afloat for a while.
segments.tr: **Tăng trưởng.** Vì nhóm giàu có chiếm phần lớn tổng tiêu dùng, chi tiêu mạnh mẽ ở cấp cao nhất có thể giữ cho tăng trưởng tổng thể nổi trong một thời gian.

segments.src: The risk is concentration: if that group pulls back, perhaps because of a fall in asset prices, there is less broad-based spending to take its place.
segments.tr: Rủi ro là sự tập trung: nếu nhóm đó rút lui, có lẽ do giá tài sản giảm, thì sẽ có ít chi tiêu rộng rãi hơn để thay thế.

segments.src: Conversely, if inflation continues to cool and wages keep rising, pressure on the rest of households could ease and the gap could narrow.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, nếu lạm phát tiếp tục hạ nhiệt và tiền lương tiếp tục tăng, áp lực lên phần còn lại của các hộ gia đình có thể giảm bớt và khoảng cách có thể thu hẹp lại.

segments.src: ## Signals worth watching into year-end
segments.tr: ## Các tín hiệu đáng chú ý khi bước vào cuối năm

segments.src: - Monthly retail sales reports, including control-group sales that feed into GDP estimates
segments.tr: - Báo cáo doanh thu bán lẻ hàng tháng, bao gồm doanh số nhóm kiểm soát đưa vào ước tính GDP

segments.src: - Delinquency and credit card balance trends from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and other sources
segments.tr: - Xu hướng số dư thẻ tín dụng và nợ quá hạn từ Ngân hàng Dự trữ Liên bang New York và các nguồn khác

segments.src: - Weekly jobless claims and monthly payroll reports
segments.tr: - Yêu cầu trợ cấp thất nghiệp hàng tuần và báo cáo bảng lương hàng tháng

segments.src: - Inflation readings, particularly for food, housing, and services
segments.tr: - Các chỉ số lạm phát, đặc biệt là đối với thực phẩm, nhà ở và dịch vụ

segments.src: - Holiday sales forecasts from industry groups, compared with actual results in December and January
segments.tr: - Dự báo doanh số bán hàng trong kỳ nghỉ từ các nhóm ngành, so với kết quả thực tế trong tháng 12 và tháng 1

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for households
segments.tr: ## Những bài học thực tế cho các hộ gia đình

segments.src: Whatever side of the split a household falls on, the holiday season is a good moment to plan carefully.
segments.tr: Dù một hộ gia đình rơi vào bên nào của sự chia rẽ, mùa lễ hội là thời điểm tốt để lên kế hoạch cẩn thận.

segments.src: Setting a firm gift budget before shopping, comparing prices, checking return policies, and avoiding debt that will linger into the new year can make the season less stressful.
segments.tr: Thiết lập ngân sách quà tặng vững chắc trước khi mua sắm, so sánh giá cả, kiểm tra chính sách đổi trả và tránh nợ nần kéo sang năm mới có thể làm cho mùa lễ ít căng thẳng hơn.

segments.src: Households with extra room in their budgets can also consider supporting local businesses, which often feel the effects of shifting consumer habits first.
segments.tr: Các hộ gia đình có thêm chỗ trống trong ngân sách cũng có thể cân nhắc hỗ trợ các doanh nghiệp địa phương, những nơi thường cảm nhận rõ tác động của việc thay đổi thói quen tiêu dùng đầu tiên.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The story of the 2026 holiday economy is not simply "strong" or "weak."
segments.tr: Câu chuyện về nền kinh tế kỳ nghỉ năm 2026 không đơn giản là "mạnh" hay "yếu".

segments.src: It is a story of different experiences under the same headline numbers.
segments.tr: Đó là câu chuyện về các trải nghiệm khác nhau dưới cùng một con số tiêu đề.

segments.src: Watching how confidence, retailer commentary, and hard spending data line up will give the clearest picture of whether the two speeds converge or drift further apart as the new year begins.
segments.tr: Việc quan sát cách niềm tin, bình luận của nhà bán lẻ và dữ liệu chi tiêu thực tế xếp hàng sẽ cung cấp bức liệu rõ ràng nhất về việc liệu hai tốc độ có hội tụ hay trôi dạt xa nhau hơn khi năm mới bắt đầu.
